text: This report provides an update on enhancements to Toronto Atmospheric Fund's (TAF) Grants Program in 2026 and recommends Board approval of the allocation of endowment proceeds to grants approved in 2025.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the allocation of funding to grants approved in 2025 as presented in Attachment 1 to the report (April 14, 2026) from the Senior Grants Manager, Toronto Atmospheric Fund.
